description:
List Shlok's projects in order of importance (the first five are flagships). Each entry has name,
        slug, field, one-line summary, tech stack, live demo and code links, its page on the portfolio, and live
        GitHub details (stars, language, topics, last update) when the code is in a public repository.
        Filters combine (all must match); a filter that matches nothing returns count 0, not an error.
        GitHub details are cached up to 6 hours and are missing for private repositories or when GitHub can't
        be reached. Use get_project for one project's full write-up and metrics, and search_portfolio for
        topics that are not projects (a skill used at work, an award).

category.description: Only one kind of project: "ai" (AI, ML and agents), "web" (full-stack and web apps), "devops" (CI/CD and infrastructure), "cloud" (serverless and cloud services), or "all". A project can be in more than one.
category.title: Category

flagship_only.description: Only the five flagship projects (his most important work). Combines with the other filters.
flagship_only.title: Flagship Only

include_other_repos.description: Also return otherRepos: his public GitHub repositories the portfolio doesn't feature (forks left out), with GitHub's description, language, stars and last update.
include_other_repos.title: Include Other Repos

tech.description: Only projects using this technology: case-insensitive, matched as part of each tech name and of the write-up, so "lang" finds LangGraph and LangChain. Examples: "LangGraph", "React", "AWS". Empty for all.
tech.title: Tech

name: list_projects
title: List projects
